title: UBS CEO Ermotti on Credit Suisse, Buyback, Volatility
summary: UBS Chief Executive Officer Sergio Ermotti says the integration of former rival Credit Suisse "is almost done." He also talks about the Zurich-based bank's announcement of a new $3 billion share buyback program to run until mid-2027, and how he expects "spikes of volatility" to continue in markets for the rest of the year. Ermotti speaks with Bloomberg's Guy Johnson. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India to Push Tax Bill For Global Bond Funds Amid Parliament Din
summary: India’s government expects Parliament to pass a bill that formalizes tax cuts for foreign investors buying its sovereign debt, according to people with knowledge of the matter, betting the legislation’s bipartisan nature will cut through other contentious debates.

title: StanChart Has Strong Capital Position, CEO Winters Says
summary: Standard Chartered Chief Executive Officer Bill Winters says the bank is happy with earnings as results beat expectations. "We feel very, very good about the momentum that we've got," he tells Bloomberg's Lizzy Burden. Winters speaks on Bloomberg Television after the London-based lender unveiled a fresh $1 billion share buyback, adding that Standard Chartered has a "strong capital position." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Deutsche Bank CFO Akram Sees Trading Momentum Continue
summary: Deutsche Bank said second-quarter fixed-income trading revenue rose 16% from a year earlier to a record €2.6 billion, beating analyst estimates and outperforming most of its Wall Street peers. Speaking to Bloomberg Television's Oliver Crook, Chief Financial Officer Raja Akram said trading has continued that momentum into July, describing the start of the month as "constructive." He added that the "pipelines look pretty full" on both the markets and investment banking sides and said the bank will “comfortably” reach its full year revenue target and if things go well, it could be “potentially a little bit better”. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Deutsche Bank CFO Sees Trading Momentum Continue in July
summary: Deutsche Bank AG Chief Financial Officer Raja Akram says trading started "constructively" in July, continuing the momentum from the previous month.
